tools.description: A file's types, functions, signatures, and docstrings with bodies stripped. Call this on a folder or a file you do not know; a directory returns its outline. Read the file you will edit, since the editor needs it.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the project or git worktree you work in. Change it when you move to another.

public_only.description: Hide private, protected, and fileprivate rows and count them (default: false).

tools.name: file_skeleton

tools.description: Find symbols by name, qualified name ('Type::method'), prefix, or concept; returns kind, path, line, signature, and id. A query that names no symbol exactly also gets the ranked matches by name words, signatures, and docs. A query that names one definition with a short body also gets that body. Use instead of grep on a name.

kind.description: Kind, such as function or class.

path.description: File or directory to search in.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the project or git worktree you work in. Change it when you move to another.

query.description: Identifier, qualified name, prefix, or a few words that describe the code.

tools.name: lookup_symbol

tools.description: The source of one symbol, with its declaration and decorators; overloads return each body. Use instead of reading a line range with Read, cat, or sed -n. Before an edit, use get_symbol_context.

file_path.description: File or folder that holds the symbol.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the project or git worktree you work in. Change it when you move to another.

symbol_id.description: The id from lookup_symbol; pass exactly one of this or symbol_name.

symbol_name.description: Name or qualified name; pass exactly one of this or symbol_id.

tools.name: get_symbol_body

tools.description: A symbol's body and return type, its callers summary, the tests to run with their commands, the markers its sibling symbols share, the signatures of what it calls, its parameter types, and open ends, in one call. Overloads return one context each, at most 4. Use before you change a function.

file_path.description: File or folder that holds the symbol.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the project or git worktree you work in. Change it when you move to another.

symbol_id.description: The id from lookup_symbol; pass exactly one of this or symbol_name.

symbol_name.description: Name or qualified name; pass exactly one of this or symbol_id.

tools.name: get_symbol_context

tools.description: Callers of a symbol: every indexed site with its name, each labeled proven, likely, unresolved, or excluded by its evidence, plus a whole-word text count that accounts for every line of the name. A field, property, variable, or constant lists its writes first. Use instead of rg or grep on a name. Callees: the calls a symbol makes. Pass file_path or a qualified name for a common name. Text reports support bounded per-section pages; each call reads the current index, keep the same project_root and filter, and restart at offset 0 after index changes. Page limit is at most 200; offset may extend beyond 200.

file_path.description: File or folder that holds the symbol.

offset.description: Text page offset in each report section (default: 0). restart at offset 0 after an index change. The offset may exceed 200.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the project or git worktree you work in. Change it when you move to another.

symbol_id.description: The id from lookup_symbol; pass exactly one of this or symbol_name.

symbol_name.description: Name or qualified name; pass exactly one of this or symbol_id.

tools.name: find_references

tools.description: The symbols a change affects and the tests to run. With no symbol, symbol_id, or file, it reads the uncommitted git changes. Text output supports bounded per-section pages and optional low-signal import, variable, parameter, field, property, module, and namespace rows. Each call reads the current index; keep the same project_root and filter, and restart at offset 0 after index changes. The page limit is at most 200; discovery stops at 200 rows and larger offsets return no rows.

include_low_signal.description: Include low-signal import, variable, parameter, field, property, module, and namespace impact rows (default: false).

offset.description: Text page offset in the test and impact sections (default: 0). restart at offset 0 after an index change. Larger offsets return no rows after the 200-row discovery ceiling.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the project or git worktree you work in. Change it when you move to another.

symbol_id.description: The id from lookup_symbol; pass one of this or symbol.

tools.name: blast_radius

tools.description: After you edit: the symbols whose shape changed against the session base (or base, or HEAD) and every site of each that your diff did not reach. Run it before you say a change is done. Text output supports bounded pages for each folded section; each call reads the current index, keep the same project_root and base, and restart at offset 0 after index changes. The default page size is 12; page limit is at most 200 and offset may extend beyond 200.

base.description: Git revision to compare with (default: the session base, else HEAD).

limit.description: Page size per folded section (default: 12 when paging is requested; maximum 200).

offset.description: Text page offset per folded section (default: 0). restart at offset 0 after an index change. The offset may exceed 200.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the project or git worktree you work in. Change it when you move to another.

tools.name: check_edit
